description: Use this when the user wants a photoshoot and you have no board_id yet. Creates a new, empty Uwear Shoot Board and returns its board_id, which every other Shoot Board tool takes. This client shows no widget: build the shoot with tools (search_uwear_library, modify_shoot_board, propose_brief) and tell the user what is on the board. prompt: one line describing the shoot; expected_types: what it needs.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for requesting user-selected items from the MCP app/gallery.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_types.description: Accepted item types (match panel tabs): 'clothing', 'models', 'outfits', 'generations', 'files'. Legacy 'file' is accepted as an alias for 'files'.

min_items.description: Minimum number of items the user must provide

prompt.description: Instruction shown to the user, e.g. 'Select the clothing items you want to use and add them to the Shoot Board'

name: request_user_context
title: New Shoot Board
